change_summary: Opt-in NHL research scenario attribution to stable skater IDs, consistent team shots, goals and goalie saves across regulation periods, with strict scope/input gates and synthetic regression CI; no production model or live prices changed.
assumptions: Player identities, complete 18-skater rosters, TOI, shot rates and conversion rates are supplied research inputs and are not independently source-authenticated.
The existing team scenario kernel does not model overtime, shootouts or first/last/assists/points/blocks, so those markets remain unsupported.
This conditional shot-goal allocation is intentionally uncalibrated, does not establish player prop skill and is not wired into production RUN IT.
Settlement must be independently confirmed as regulation-only; absent a source rule, pricing fails closed.
All created tests are synthetic and no bettor performance, CLV, risk certification or genuine model improvement is claimed.

baseline.metric: Real graded player-prop calibration of shared NHL regulation simulation
